blocks.heading: Reuse a layout
blocks.body:
An **Experience Fragment** is a reusable chunk of page layout. A promo strip. A footer. Something you would otherwise copy from page to page.

It is not a **conref**. A conref reuses a piece of XML in Oxygen. You did that in week 4. Different desk, different file.

It is not a **Content Fragment**. That is a fill-in form of fields. You will meet it next week. Do not mix the names.

Use an Experience Fragment for ‘Shop HP-40’ on two pages. Do not store the handbook there. Do not store a procedure there.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: The log says an Experience Fragment is a conref, or a procedure is stored in the fragment as the handbook.

Expected: Three-way distinction written. One Kitepump promo idea. One ‘would not’. Mock labeled.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week10/field-log-67.txt: Experience Fragment = a reusable page layout (header promo, footer strip). Next week you will meet Content Fragments, which are fill-in forms. A DITA conref is XML reuse in Oxygen. Three different things.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Kitepump: a promo strip ‘Shop HP-40’ could appear on two pages. The pinch warning stays a DITA reuse in the handbook.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write when you would not use an Experience Fragment: a one-off sentence, or a procedure.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Labeled mock: two pages sharing a promo strip. Caption: mock. Not a conref arrow.

blocks.summary: Three-way distinction written. One Kitepump promo idea. One ‘would not’. Mock labeled.

blocks.q: You want the pinch warning on two AEM pages. Do you put it in an Experience Fragment?
options: Yes :  an Experience Fragment is a conref
No :  that sentence is DITA. Link to the handbook, or paraphrase. Do not pretend the fragment is the warning library
blocks.why: Safety lines stay in the handbook. An Experience Fragment is layout.

blocks.q: A header used on 40 pages. Copy-paste the blocks each time, or reuse a layout strip?
options: Reuse a layout strip (Experience Fragment or the template) :  that is the point
blocks.why: Layout you would otherwise copy from page to page is the job.
